veranderings.voor: By 'n drom is dit die vel waarop jy geklop het wat vibreer.
veranderings.na: By 'n drom vibreer die vel waarop jy geklop het.
veranderings.rede: Two stacked relative clauses ('waarop ... wat vibreer') make the sentence hard to parse for Grade 4; the plain main-clause order says the same thing.

veranderings.voor: klop met jou hand op die vel
veranderings.na: klop met jou hand op die drom se vel
veranderings.rede: 'die vel' has no antecedent, because no skin has been mentioned yet; naming the drum makes the reference clear.
